Ranks Montgomery census tracts by the increase in code violation count from 2024 to 2025, joining all tracts to per-year counts and ordering the increase descending with tract name as tiebreaker.
sql:
WITH obs AS (
  SELECT geoid, year, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM fw_pg.tract_observations
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_8ffad2'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND geoid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY geoid, year
),
piv AS (
  SELECT geoid,
         SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS violations_2024,
         SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS violations_2025
  FROM obs
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT t.name,
       (COALESCE(p.violations_2025, 0) - COALESCE(p.violations_2024, 0)) AS increase_in_code_violations,
       COALESCE(p.violations_2024, 0) AS violations_2024,
       COALESCE(p.violations_2025, 0) AS violations_2025,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN piv p ON t.geoid = p.geoid
ORDER BY increase_in_code_violations DESC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
